anomalies.obs: In the ATO Valve driver the gate-bias resistor R12 (10k) is wired between the T5 (AO3400A) gate node and GND (a pull-DOWN), whereas the identical main-pump driver uses R5 (10k) as a pull-UP to +3V3. T4 (BT3904) is an NPN common-emitter sink (emitter to GND), so the T5 gate can only ever be pulled low; nothing raises it.
anomalies.exp: With an NPN open-collector level shifter sinking a low-side N-MOS gate, the gate needs a pull-up to +3V3 (as R5 provides for T2) so that the MOSFET can turn on when the NPN is off. The spec's intended ATO valve switch (T3/T4/R10) is expected to actually energize the solenoid.

evidence.quote: ATO Valve: 'R12 10k' drawn from the T5 gate node down to a ground symbol, while Main Pump shows 'R5 10k' drawn from +3V3 down to the T2 gate node (sheet 1 bottom / sheet 3)
T3 — AON6407 ... ATO solenoid-valve low-side switch ... gate driven through R10 (100 Ω), pre-driven via T4 (BT3904)

anomalies.impact: The ATO solenoid valve gate is permanently held at ground, so T5 never conducts and the valve can never open regardless of the ATO_VALVE GPIO. Automatic Top-Off, a core feature, would fail to operate.

anomalies.obs: The 'Water Height Sensor' block wires the TF-Luna LiDAR PR1 to header H1, connecting PR1 VCC/SCL/SDA to +5V/I2C_SCL/I2C_SDA and PR1 TR to H1 pin 5, which carries the EZO_PDIS net. Thus the isolator power-disable control net is merged with the sensor header / LiDAR trigger.
anomalies.exp: Spec §4.3/§6 state PR1's pins are typed 'free' and it is not connected to any net (on_board: no); spec §4.2 states EZO_PDIS ties only U3.8, U4.8 and IO6. The LiDAR should not load the I2C bus nor share the EZO_PDIS control net.

the r2 netlist shows PR1 ... all four pins (VCC, SDA, SCL, GND) typed free — i.e., it is not connected to any net

anomalies.impact: An unpopulated-by-firmware device is added to the I2C bus and the EZO_PDIS disable line is bridged to the sensor header; toggling IO6 to power-cycle the isolators also pulses the LiDAR trigger, and the extra bus load can disturb I2C.

anomalies.obs: The AON6407 (T3) is used as the 24 V input reverse-polarity switch (with R7/D3), and the ATO solenoid is switched by the small SOT-23 AO3400A (T5).
anomalies.exp: Spec §2 assigns the AON6407 (T3) to the ATO solenoid-valve low-side switch; a 24 V solenoid with only a 30 V-rated, low-current SOT-23 MOSFET is marginal.

anomalies.impact: The valve MOSFET is a smaller part than intended (30 V SOT-23) with limited margin against solenoid inrush and flyback spikes; combined with the R12 gate fault the valve path is unreliable.
